notes: Portrait sheet (HEIGHT AND BULK DISTRICTS, SHEET 4H, 1978). No frame rule on the left or right: blank paper out to the page edges, so the outline follows them (README rule 5). Top: a thick printed rule (~14 px, x ~22-2972, sloping from y ~108-117 at the left to ~127-137 at the right) runs across the top margin with only blank paper above; it is treated as the top frame rule and the outline sits ~1.5 px below its lower edge (rule 1), carried on along its slope out to both page edges. Doubt: the series' p01 label has no such rule (it follows the top page edge); here the rule is printed, so the paper above it is outside. Bottom: just above the top edge of the thick bar (~26 px) that rules off the legend/title strip (HEIGHT AND BULK DISTRICTS, OS legend, code note, north arrow, SHEET 4H), rule 3; the bar's edge was measured column by column (y ~3847 at the left, ~3829 at the right), carried on to both page edges. No remove polygons: the north arrow is in the legend strip. 'SEE SHEET 3H' and 'SEE SHEET 5H' are cross-references (inside); PACIFIC OCEAN, LINCOLN PARK, GOLDEN GATE PARK and the codes are map. No ink under the outline.
